exact_statement: Let a(g) be the finite minimum influence over invertible affine spectral maps of a finite uniform Boolean sign g. If f is affine-influence minimal, its full child release rho_i=E[I(f_i)-a(f_i)] obeys 0<=rho_i<=sum_{j!=i}min(p_i,p_j), with sharp coefficient1. If I(f)<=a(f)+delta, the upper bound becomes sum_{j!=i}min(p_j,p_i+delta); epsilon-near finite D_K maxima have delta<=epsilon/K for K>0. For any nonempty physical A define rho_A=E[I(child)-a(child)], S_Astar=E[K a(child)-H(child)], D=H-KI, and L_A=H-EH(child). Then S_A=S_Astar+K rho_A and D+S_Astar=L_A-K(I_A+rho_A). For k in1..n, M=binom(n,k), t=binom(n-1,k-1), T_k=tH-sum_{|A|=k}H(S_A|S_Ac)>=0: T_k+(M-t)D+sum S_Astar+K sum rho_A=sum J_A<=2tI/ln2. On a least-essential-dimensional positive K-violation all S_Astar>=0, giving K sum rho_A+(M-t)D<=2tI/ln2. For every finite adaptive restriction tree followed by branch-dependent entropy-preserving nonincreasing-influence affine resets, sum w(query_I+reset_release)=I(root)-E I(leaves) and sum w L=H(root)-E H(leaves), so each reset is spent once and complete terminal deficits are retained. No uniformly paid pair/tree is selected.
hypotheses: Finite uniform Boolean signs, normalized real Walsh coefficients, entropy bits
Finite affine orbit contains identity; all child entropies and original branch reaches retained
Local bound requires affine influence minimality, or explicitly I-a<=delta for its tolerance form
Critical budget requires nonviolation of EVERY smaller-dimensional Boolean function, not only unoptimized physical children; K>0
Tree resets have nonincreasing influence in each actual current chart; no global common chart assumed
proof_dependencies: Elementary physical restriction, conditional entropy chain and finite tree telescopes
